"""Canvas presentation, sprite animation, interface, atmosphere, and cinematics."""
import math
import random
from .settings import DISPLAY, THEME, ARENA, MATCH, FIGHTERS, AI, GRAPHICS
from .combat import WIDTH, HEIGHT, FLOOR, ATTACKS
from .moves import move_spec
from .cinematics import draw_finisher

class Renderer:
    def __init__(self,canvas,art,app):
        self.c=canvas;self.art=art;self.app=app;self.clock=0;self.buttons=[];self.tag='ui'
        self.rng=random.Random(81)
        self.embers=[(self.rng.random()*WIDTH,self.rng.random()*HEIGHT,self.rng.uniform(.4,1.4)) for _ in range(GRAPHICS['ambient_embers'])]
        self.c.create_image(0,0,image=art.background,anchor='nw',tags=('background',))
    def rect(self,x,y,w,h,color,outline='',width=1):
        self.c.create_rectangle(x,y,x+w,y+h,fill=color,outline=outline,width=width,tags=('frame',self.tag))
    def poly(self,points,color,outline='',width=1):
        self.c.create_polygon(*[v for p in points for v in p],fill=color,outline=outline,width=width,tags=('frame',self.tag))
    def line(self,points,color,width=1):
        self.c.create_line(*[v for p in points for v in p],fill=color,width=width,capstyle='round',tags=('frame',self.tag))
    def oval(self,x,y,rx,ry,color='',outline='',width=1):
        self.c.create_oval(x-rx,y-ry,x+rx,y+ry,fill=color,outline=outline,width=width,tags=('frame',self.tag))
    def text(self,x,y,value,size=14,color=None,anchor='center',font='Helvetica',weight='bold',wrap=0):
        self.c.create_text(x,y,text=value,fill=color or THEME['text'],font=(font,-size,weight),anchor=anchor,width=wrap,justify='left',tags=('frame',self.tag))
    def diamond(self,x,y,size,color):self.poly([(x,y-size),(x+size,y),(x,y+size),(x-size,y)],color)
    def button(self,x,y,w,h,title,fn,color=None,sub=''):
        color=color or THEME['gold'];mx,my=self.app.mouse;hover=x<=mx<=x+w and y<=my<=y+h
        self.poly([(x,y),(x+w,y),(x+w,y+h-8),(x+w-8,y+h),(x,y+h)],'#292322' if hover else '#131215',color,2 if hover else 1)
        self.rect(x,y,3,h,color);self.text(x+15,y+h/2-(8 if sub else 0),title,14,color,'w')
        if sub:self.text(x+15,y+h/2+15,sub,9,THEME['muted'],'w',weight='normal')
        self.buttons.append((x,y,w,h,fn))
    def atmosphere(self):
        if not GRAPHICS['particles']:return
        for x,y,speed in self.embers:
            yy=(y-self.clock*32*speed)%HEIGHT;xx=x+math.sin(self.clock*.5+x)*16
            if 115<yy<FLOOR:self.oval(xx,yy,1.2*speed,1.8*speed,'#be7046')
        for j in range(3):
            x=(self.clock*18+j*430)%1500-220
            self.line([(x,FLOOR-6-j*11),(x+170,FLOOR-8-j*11)],'#514640',1)
    def sprite(self,f,x=None,y=None,portrait=False,override=None):
        x=f.x if x is None else x;y=FLOOR-f.z if y is None else y
        action=override or f.action
        pose='portrait' if portrait else action
        if not portrait and action in ATTACKS:
            spec=move_spec(f.name,action);pose=spec.get('pose','cast' if action in ('blast','super') else action)
            if spec['kind']=='flurry':
                poses=spec['poses'];pose=poses[min(len(poses)-1,int(f.elapsed/spec['duration']*len(poses))) ]
        if not portrait:
            if action in ('idle','walk'):
                pose='walk' if action=='walk' and math.sin(self.clock*14)>0 else 'idle'
            elif action=='dash':pose='walk'
            elif action=='victory':pose='idle'
            elif action=='hurt':pose='hurt'
            if f.z>0 and action not in ('jab','kick','blast','signature','super','hurt','ko'):pose='jump'
        if pose not in ('portrait','idle','walk','jab','kick','guard','jump','cast','hurt','ko','duck'):pose='idle'
        if action!='ko':
            self.oval(x,FLOOR if not portrait else y,66 if not portrait else 87,9,'#0c0a0e','#292129',1)
            self.oval(x,FLOOR if not portrait else y,48,4,'',FIGHTERS[f.name]['dark'],1)
        image,padding=self.art.frame(f.name,pose,f.facing)
        bob=math.sin(self.clock*3.8+(0 if f.facing>0 else 1.8))*1.5 if action in ('idle','walk') else 0
        self.c.create_image(x,y+padding+bob,image=image,anchor='s',tags=('frame',self.tag))
        if action=='guard' and not portrait:
            self.oval(x+f.facing*55,y-132,27,80,'',f.color,1.5)
        if f.flash>.04 and GRAPHICS['hit_flash']:
            self.oval(x,y-125,64,101,'',f.color,1.5)
        if action in ('blast','super') and move_spec(f.name,action)['kind']=='projectile' and f.elapsed<move_spec(f.name,action)['start']:
            r=20 if action=='blast' else 39
            for add in (0,9,18):self.oval(x+f.facing*70,y-130,r+add,r+add,'',f.color,1)
        if action in ('super','signature') and not portrait:
            for j in range(3):
                angle=self.clock*10+j*.5
                self.line([(x+math.cos(angle)*75,y-120+math.sin(angle)*65),
                           (x+math.cos(angle+.4)*102,y-120+math.sin(angle+.4)*82)],f.color,2)
        if action in ATTACKS and not portrait:
            spec=move_spec(f.name,action)
            if spec.get('effect')=='quake':
                for timing in spec.get('hits',[spec['start']]):
                    age=f.elapsed-timing
                    if 0<=age<.42:
                        radius=30+age*420
                        for j in range(3):self.oval(x+f.facing*65,FLOOR-4,radius+j*14,9+j*5,'',f.color,2)
    def title(self):
        self.poly([(0,0),(618,0),(573,HEIGHT),(0,HEIGHT)],'#09090d')
        self.line([(617,0),(573,HEIGHT)],THEME['border'],1)
        self.text(48,32,'ACTION ICONS ENTER THE TEMPLE',10,THEME['muted'],'w',font='Menlo')
        self.diamond(57,56,6,THEME['gold']);self.line([(75,56),(307,56)],THEME['border'])
        self.text(44,96,'SHADOW',49,THEME['gold_light'],'w',font='Georgia')
        self.text(48,147,'RECKONING',39,THEME['gold'],'w',font='Georgia')
        self.text(49,192,'EIGHT LEGENDS. ONE SURVIVOR.',12,THEME['text'],'w')
        for i,label in enumerate(('YOUR FIGHTER','OPPONENT')):
            self.button(49+i*243,217,230,31,('●  ' if self.app.selection_slot==i else '')+label,
                        lambda n=i:setattr(self.app,'selection_slot',n),THEME['gold'] if self.app.selection_slot==i else '#6e6462')
        for i,(name,f) in enumerate(FIGHTERS.items()):
            x=49+(i%2)*243;y=261+(i//2)*55
            self.button(x,y,230,48,'',lambda n=name:self.app.choose(n),f['main'])
            thumb,_=self.art.frame(name,'thumb',1)
            self.c.create_image(x+27,y+24,image=thumb,tags=('frame',self.tag))
            self.text(x+55,y+16,'THE ROCK' if name=='ROCK' else name,13,f['main'],'w')
            self.text(x+55,y+35,f.get('inspiration',f['title']),8,THEME['muted'],'w',weight='normal')
            if self.app.selected==name:self.text(x+214,y+13,'P1',8,f['light'])
            if self.app.opponent==name:self.text(x+214,y+26,'P2',8,f['main'])
        self.text(49,494,'CHOOSE YOUR TRIAL',10,THEME['gold'],'w',font='Menlo')
        for i,level in enumerate(AI['levels']):
            self.button(49+i*162,513,148,31,level['name'],lambda n=i:setattr(self.app,'difficulty',n),THEME['gold'] if i==self.app.difficulty else '#5c5453')
        self.button(49,562,150,52,'ARCADE',lambda:self.app.start('arcade'),sub='ENTER  /  VERSUS CPU')
        self.button(211,562,150,52,'LOCAL DUEL',lambda:self.app.start('versus'),sub='V  /  TWO PLAYERS')
        self.button(373,562,150,52,'TRAINING',lambda:self.app.start('training'),sub='T  /  PRACTICE')
        self.text(49,634,'A / D  CHOOSE   TAB  SWITCH SLOT   F1  MOVES',10,THEME['muted'],'w',font='Menlo')
        self.text(49,651,'G  OPTIONS   M  SOUND   ← / →  OPPONENT',9,THEME['muted'],'w',font='Menlo')
        from .combat import Fighter
        self.sprite(Fighter(self.app.opponent,WIDTH-168,-1),x=WIDTH-168,y=536,portrait=True)
        self.sprite(Fighter(self.app.selected,WIDTH-368,1),x=WIDTH-368,y=536,portrait=True)
        for name,x,label in ((self.app.selected,WIDTH-368,'PLAYER ONE'),(self.app.opponent,WIDTH-168,'OPPONENT')):
            self.text(x,559,label,9,THEME['muted'],font='Menlo')
            self.text(x,584,'THE ROCK' if name=='ROCK' else name,25,FIGHTERS[name]['main'],font='Georgia')
            self.text(x,609,FIGHTERS[name]['discipline'],9,THEME['gold_light'])
        self.text(WIDTH-268,137,'CHOOSE YOUR ICONS',12,THEME['gold'],font='Menlo')
        self.text(WIDTH-268,375,'VS',27,THEME['gold_light'],font='Georgia')
        self.text(WIDTH-268,641,ARENA['name'],9,THEME['muted'],font='Menlo')
        self.text(WIDTH-28,26,'M  '+('SOUND ON' if self.app.audio.enabled else 'MUTED'),9,THEME['gold'],'e',font='Menlo')
    def move_guide(self):
        self.rect(25,24,WIDTH-50,HEIGHT-48,'#0b0a0f',THEME['gold'])
        self.text(55,62,'THE ART OF KOMBAT',28,THEME['gold_light'],'w',font='Georgia')
        self.text(WIDTH-55,62,'F1 / ESC  RETURN',11,THEME['gold'],'e',font='Menlo')
        if self.app.moves_resume in ('title','options'):
            names=[self.app.selected,self.app.opponent]
        else:names=[f.name for f in self.app.engine.fighters]
        for i,name in enumerate(names):
            x=55+i*520;f=FIGHTERS[name]
            self.text(x,111,('P1   ' if i==0 else 'P2   ')+name,24,f['main'],'w',font='Georgia')
            self.text(x,140,f['discipline'],10,THEME['muted'],'w',font='Menlo')
            labels=('J','K','L','E','I','F') if i==0 else ('U','O','P','H','N','Y')
            moves=[('jab','QUICK JAB'),('kick','HEAVY KICK'),('blast','POWER'),('signature','SIGNATURE'),('super','SUPER'),('finish','FATALITY')]
            for row,((action,fallback),key) in enumerate(zip(moves,labels)):
                y=178+row*47
                self.rect(x,y,29,27,'#221c23',f['dark']);self.text(x+14,y+14,key,12,f['light'],font='Menlo')
                spec=move_spec(name,action) if action!='finish' else {}
                label=spec.get('label',f['finisher'] if action=='finish' else fallback)
                self.text(x+42,y+7,label,13,THEME['text'],'w')
                detail=('FATALITY · after the deciding win / preview in training' if action=='finish' else
                        ('SUPER · '+str(len(spec['hits']))+' hits · 100 energy' if 'hits' in spec else
                         ('SUPER · GRAB · jump to evade' if action=='super' and spec.get('kind')=='grapple' else
                          'SUPER · 100 energy' if action=='super' else
                          str(spec['cost'])+' energy · GRAB · jump to evade' if spec.get('kind')=='grapple' else
                          str(spec['cost'])+' energy · ground shock · jump to evade' if spec.get('effect')=='quake' else
                          str(spec['cost'])+' energy' if spec['cost'] else 'No energy required')))
                self.text(x+42,y+26,detail,9,THEME['muted'],'w',weight='normal')
            self.text(x,486,'WASD  MOVE / JUMP / DUCK' if i==0 else 'ARROWS  MOVE / JUMP / DUCK',10,f['light'],'w',font='Menlo')
            self.text(x,508,'SPACE  GUARD     LEFT SHIFT  DASH' if i==0 else 'RIGHT SHIFT  GUARD     ENTER  DASH',10,THEME['muted'],'w',font='Menlo')
        self.line([(55,535),(WIDTH-55,535)],THEME['border'])
        self.text(55,561,'ARCADE INPUTS',10,THEME['gold'],'w',font='Menlo')
        self.text(55,586,'↓, toward, punch = signature     ↓, toward, power = super',12,THEME['text'],'w')
        self.text(55,610,'↓, ↓, kick = fatality during FINISH THEM.  Enter each sequence quickly.',11,THEME['muted'],'w')
    def hud(self,e):
        center=WIDTH/2;bar=(WIDTH-260)/2
        self.poly([(0,0),(WIDTH,0),(WIDTH,105),(center+72,105),(center+53,91),(center-53,91),(center-72,105),(0,105)],'#0b0a0e')
        for i,f in enumerate(e.fighters):
            x=38 if i==0 else WIDTH-38-bar;label=('P1  ' if i==0 else 'P2  ' if e.mode=='versus' else 'CPU  ')+f.name
            self.text(x,25,label,20,f.color,'w',font='Georgia')
            self.text(x+bar,25,FIGHTERS[f.name]['title'],9,THEME['muted'],'e')
            self.rect(x-2,47,bar+4,25,'#1b1718',THEME['gold'],1)
            hp=bar*f.hp/100;ghost=bar*f.ghost_hp/100
            sx=x if i==0 else x+bar-ghost;self.rect(sx,49,ghost,21,'#cebdad')
            sx=x if i==0 else x+bar-hp;self.rect(sx,49,hp,21,f.color)
            self.rect(sx,49,hp,3,FIGHTERS[f.name]['light'])
            for k in range(4):
                bx=x+k*44;self.rect(bx,82,38,6,'#302834')
                self.rect(bx,82,38*max(0,min(1,(f.meter-k*25)/25)),6,THEME['gold_light'] if f.meter>=100 else f.color)
            self.text(x+184,86,'SOUL CHARGED' if f.meter>=100 else f'SOUL  {int(f.meter)}',9,THEME['gold'] if f.meter>=100 else THEME['muted'],'w')
            for k in range(MATCH['wins_required']):self.diamond(x+bar-7-k*18,85,5,THEME['gold'] if f.wins>k else '#383031')
            if f.guarding:self.rect(x,98,bar*f.guard/100,2,THEME['gold_light'])
            if f.combo>=2:
                xx=85 if i==0 else WIDTH-85
                self.text(xx,173,str(f.combo),48,f.color,font='Georgia');self.text(xx,205,'HIT COMBO',11,THEME['gold_light'])
        self.text(center,20,'FIRST TO '+str(MATCH['wins_required']),8,THEME['muted'],font='Menlo')
        self.text(center,57,'∞' if e.training else f'{math.ceil(e.timer):02}',39,THEME['gold_light'],font='Georgia')
        self.text(center,128,ARENA['name']+'   /   ROUND '+str(e.round),10,THEME['gold_light'],font='Menlo')
        self.rect(0,HEIGHT-87,WIDTH,87,'#0b0a0e');self.line([(0,HEIGHT-87),(WIDTH,HEIGHT-87)],THEME['border'])
        if e.mode=='versus':
            self.text(26,HEIGHT-63,'P1  WASD MOVE · J JAB · K KICK · L POWER · E SIGNATURE · I SUPER · SPACE GUARD · SHIFT DASH',10,e.fighters[0].color,'w',font='Menlo')
            self.text(26,HEIGHT-39,'P2  ARROWS MOVE · U JAB · O KICK · P POWER · H SIGNATURE · N SUPER · R-SHIFT GUARD · ENTER DASH',10,e.fighters[1].color,'w',font='Menlo')
            detail='F / Y  FATALITY AFTER MATCH WIN'
        else:
            self.text(26,HEIGHT-64,'WASD MOVE · SPACE GUARD · SHIFT DASH · J JAB · K KICK · L POWER · E SIGNATURE · I SUPER',11,THEME['gold_light'],'w',font='Menlo')
            detail='B  DUMMY GUARD '+('ON' if e.dummy_guard else 'OFF')+'   /   F  FATALITY PREVIEW' if e.training else 'WIN TWO ROUNDS. PRESS F DURING FINISH THEM TO UNLEASH YOUR FATALITY.'
        self.text(26,HEIGHT-18,detail,9,THEME['muted'],'w',font='Menlo')
        self.text(WIDTH-24,HEIGHT-63,'F1 MOVES',10,THEME['gold'],'e',font='Menlo')
        self.text(WIDTH-24,HEIGHT-39,'ESC PAUSE',9,THEME['gold'],'e',font='Menlo')
        self.text(WIDTH-24,HEIGHT-18,'M '+('SOUND' if self.app.audio.enabled else 'MUTED'),9,THEME['muted'],'e',font='Menlo')
    def projectiles(self,e):
        for p in e.projectiles:
            pal=FIGHTERS[e.fighters[p.owner].name];r=36 if p.super else 20;x=p.x;y=FLOOR-p.z
            for j in range(5,0,-1):
                self.oval(x-p.direction*j*16,y,r+j*2,r*.70,pal['dark'] if j>2 else pal['main'])
            self.oval(x,y,r,r,pal['main'],pal['light'],2);self.oval(x+p.direction*4,y,r*.48,r*.7,pal['light'])
            for j in range(5):
                a=self.clock*10+j*math.tau/5
                self.line([(x+math.cos(a)*r,y+math.sin(a)*r),(x+math.cos(a+.7)*r*1.8,y+math.sin(a+.7)*r*1.8)],pal['main'],2)
    def effects(self,e):
        if not GRAPHICS['particles']:return
        for p in e.particles:
            ratio=p.life/p.maxlife
            if p.kind=='echo':self.oval(p.x,p.y-40,40,91,'',p.color,1)
            else:self.line([(p.x,p.y),(p.x-p.vx*.025*ratio,p.y-p.vy*.025*ratio)],p.color,max(1,p.size*ratio))
    def panel(self,title,subtitle,color=None):
        x=WIDTH/2-280;self.rect(x,194,560,237,'#0d0b11',THEME['gold'])
        self.rect(x,194,560,3,color or THEME['gold']);self.text(WIDTH/2,255,title,41,color or THEME['gold_light'],font='Georgia')
        self.text(WIDTH/2,302,subtitle,12,THEME['muted'])
    def options(self):
        self.panel('OPTIONS','Changes apply immediately for this session.')
        self.button(WIDTH/2-235,332,150,43,'SOUND '+('ON' if self.app.audio.enabled else 'OFF'),self.app.audio.toggle)
        self.button(WIDTH/2-75,332,150,43,'SHAKE '+('ON' if GRAPHICS['camera_shake'] else 'OFF'),lambda:GRAPHICS.update(camera_shake=not GRAPHICS['camera_shake']))
        self.button(WIDTH/2+85,332,150,43,'EMBERS '+('ON' if GRAPHICS['particles'] else 'OFF'),lambda:GRAPHICS.update(particles=not GRAPHICS['particles']))
        self.text(WIDTH/2,405,'ESC / G  RETURN      F11  FULLSCREEN',10,THEME['gold'],font='Menlo')
    def cinematic(self,e):
        draw_finisher(self,e)
    def render(self,dt):
        self.clock+=dt;self.buttons=[];self.c.delete('frame');self.tag='world';self.atmosphere()
        e=self.app.engine
        if e.state=='moves':
            self.tag='ui';self.move_guide();return
        if e.state in ('title','options'):
            self.tag='ui';self.title()
            if e.state=='options':self.buttons=[];self.options()
            return
        if e.state=='finisher':self.cinematic(e);return
        for i,f in enumerate(e.fighters):
            override='idle' if e.state=='finish_window' and i==e.winner else 'hurt' if e.state=='finish_window' else None
            self.sprite(f,override=override)
        self.projectiles(e);self.effects(e)
        if GRAPHICS['camera_shake'] and e.shake>0:self.c.move('world',self.rng.uniform(-e.shake,e.shake),self.rng.uniform(-e.shake*.3,e.shake*.3))
        self.tag='ui'
        if e.state=='finisher':self.cinematic(e);return
        self.hud(e)
        if e.state=='intro':
            self.text(WIDTH/2,238,'TRAINING' if e.training else 'ROUND '+str(e.round),55,THEME['gold_light'],font='Georgia')
            self.text(WIDTH/2,283,'FIND YOUR DISCIPLINE' if e.training else 'THE TEMPLE DEMANDS A VICTOR',11,THEME['gold'],font='Menlo')
        elif e.state=='paused':
            self.panel('PAUSED','The temple can wait.')
            self.button(WIDTH/2-235,348,225,48,'ENTER  RESUME',self.app.resume)
            self.button(WIDTH/2+10,348,225,48,'Q  MAIN MENU',self.app.to_title)
        elif e.state=='finish_window':
            self.text(WIDTH/2,213,'FINISH THEM',58,THEME['danger'],font='Georgia')
            key='F' if e.winner==0 else 'Y' if e.mode=='versus' else ''
            self.text(WIDTH/2,267,(key+'  /  FATALITY     OR     ↓ ↓ + KICK') if key else 'YOUR FATE IS SEALED',13,THEME['gold_light'])
        elif e.state=='match_end':
            win=e.winner==0 or e.mode=='versus';champ=e.fighters[e.winner].name
            self.panel('VICTORY' if win else 'DEFEAT',champ+' CLAIMS THE ECLIPSE THRONE',FIGHTERS[champ]['main'])
            self.button(WIDTH/2-235,348,225,48,'ENTER  REMATCH',lambda:self.app.start(e.mode))
            self.button(WIDTH/2+10,348,225,48,'MAIN MENU',self.app.to_title)
        elif e.state=='training_reset':self.text(WIDTH/2,231,'THE TRIAL CONTINUES',34,THEME['gold'],font='Georgia')
        elif e.message_time>0:
            size=63 if e.message in ('FIGHT','K.O.') else 25
            self.text(WIDTH/2+2,226,e.message,size,'#130a11',font='Georgia')
            self.text(WIDTH/2,223,e.message,size,THEME['gold_light'],font='Georgia')
